<slate title="Thread cost">
  <column id="root">
    <row id="money" between>
      <number id="spent" usd large label="Spent this thread" value={thread.cost.usd} />
      <number
        id="rate"
        usd
        label="Workspace per hour"
        value={cost.rateUsdPerHour}
        note={cost.rateUsdPerHour == 0 ? 'free on this Mac' : `${usd(cost.accruedUsd)} run up so far`}
      />
    </row>
    <row id="tokens" between>
      <number id="input" tokens label="Input tokens" value={thread.tokens.input} />
      <number id="output" tokens label="Output tokens" value={thread.tokens.output} />
    </row>
    <number
      id="last-turn"
      duration
      label="Last turn took"
      value={thread.lastTurn.durationMs}
      note={exists(thread.lastTurn.endedAt) ? `ended ${ago(thread.lastTurn.endedAt)}` : 'still running'}
      when={exists(thread.lastTurn)}
    />
    <text id="no-turn" muted small when={isNull(thread.lastTurn)}>No turn has run yet.</text>
  </column>
</slate>
